deadline.quote: The deadline for Fall 2027 is December 1, 2026.

gre_subject.value: No subject GRE is mentioned; GRE scores are not required.

gre_general.quote: Graduate Record Examination (GRE) scores are NOT REQUIRED.

supervisor.value: Students are normally admitted to work with a specific faculty mentor, so contact faculty before the deadline; rarely, students rotate first.
supervisor.quote: Students are normally admitted to work with a specific faculty mentor. As such, we highly recommend that you reach out to faculty before the application deadline.

funding.value: All students, including international, get a stipend (at least USD 31,500), tuition and health insurance while in good standing; at least one term of teaching.
funding.quote: Funding: All students, both domestic and international, receive an annual stipend, tuition, and health insurance while in good academic standing.

entry_route.value: Applicants come from a wide range of degree backgrounds; a GPA of 3.0 over the last 60 undergraduate hours is expected, and a master's can make up for a lower GPA.
entry_route.quote: Applicants should have a grade-point average of at least 3.0 (4.0 = A) for the last 60 hours of undergraduate study. Master’s degrees and significant post-bac experience can make up for this.

notes: Previous research experience in neuroscience or a related field is required. No application fee waivers for international students. TOEFL, IELTS or Duolingo accepted.
